relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: sequencing of three families with congenital insensitivity to pain confirmed a channelopathy in SCN9A and therein established Nav1.7 as a key mediator of nociceptive pain

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: knockout of Scn10a, which encodes for Nav1.8, reduces inflammatory sensitivity to mechanical and thermal stimulation

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Given that TRPV1 serves both an afferent function in integrating painful stimuli and an efferent function in initiating neurogenic inflammation

key_findings: Compendium of 242 validated pain genes; pain genes are more often expressed in DRG sensory neurons than non-neurons.
Nav1.7 inhibitors and TRP antagonists have failed clinically due to selectivity and on-target effects.
